title: Grade 7 Lessons 7 9
description: Grade 7 multiple-choice question bank. Each question has four options and one correct answer.

questions.question: Which statement best describes malware?

options.text: Software designed to harm, disrupt, spy on, or gain unauthorized access to a computer or network
Software used only to create presentations
A tool that always protects a computer
A website used for online shopping

questions.question: Malware aims to breach a computer system's security policy. Which three areas does it target?

options.text: Screen brightness, sound, and keyboard layout
Confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information or systems

questions.question: Through which route can both viruses and worms spread?

options.text: Only when a user prints a document
Through infected files, removable media, networks, or other connected devices

questions.question: Maya gets a text message that seems to come from her school's IT team. It says her account will close unless she clicks a link and types in her password. What is this an example of?
All the files on a school's computers suddenly show a message demanding bitcoin for a key. The technician says the school can still return its files to their original state. What makes this possible?

options.text: Restoring clean backups that were made before the attack

questions.question: Ana downloads a free game from a pop-up because it looks fun. Soon her files start being deleted, but the game never copies itself to other computers. Which type of malware is this?

Four school computers each have a different problem: a worm, a trojan horse, ransomware, or spyware. Computer 1's files are locked until a bitcoin payment is made. On Computer 2, the owner installed a fun free app that turned out to be harmful. Computer 3 secretly sends the owner's browsing habits to another company. Which problem is on Computer 4?
A trojan horse pretends to be a useful or fun app. In the same way, a phishing message pretends to be:

options.text: A trusted person or organization, such as a bank or school
A harmless offline document in every case

questions.question: Put these steps of a virus infection in the correct order: P: It spreads from device to device. Q: It stays dormant in the user's system. R: The user activates it.

Two attacks are described: Attack A uses a fake trusted message to make the user click a link. Attack B redirects the user to a fake website even when the correct address is entered. Which combination correctly identifies both attacks?
In a P2P network, what is a seed?

options.text: A peer that has the complete file and makes it available for others to download
A peer that has never connected to the internet
A computer virus hidden in a file
A website that sells computer parts

questions.question: In the lesson, which term describes the peer that downloads a file?
What is copyright?

options.text: A method for making a computer faster
Legal protection giving creators certain rights over how their original work is used

questions.question: What is a peer in a P2P network?

options.text: A person who owns a copyright certificate
A computer that can only receive files
A computer or device that can share resources directly with other devices in the network

questions.question: Omar uses P2P software to download a school project video that Zara created and is hosting from her computer. What is Omar's role called?
A student's computer stops an infected file from opening, even though nobody scanned it. Which security features may detect compromised files like this?

options.text: Real-time antivirus protection or built-in security scanning

questions.question: Lena wants to download a popular song from the internet. According to the lesson, what is important to check before downloading it?

options.text: Whether the file name is colourful
Whether the song is popular among friends
Whether the download source is legitimate and the use is permitted by copyright
Whether the file can be renamed

questions.question: Peer A makes a file available to others. Peer B receives that file through the P2P network. What can you conclude?

options.text: Peer A must be a firewall
Peer B must own the copyright
Peer A is acting as a seed and Peer B as a downloader or leecher

questions.question: Zoe sees four file names. Which one is the odd one out because it runs as a program instead of holding a picture, text, or music?
Which option does NOT belong with the other three based on its use?

options.text: A seed sharing a complete file

questions.question: What is the correct order in which anti-virus software handles a detected virus?

options.text: Detect the threat → quarantine or isolate it → remove or otherwise deal with it safely
Delete all files → turn off the monitor → detect the virus
Install a game → share the infected file → scan later
Ignore the threat → open the file → restart the computer

questions.question: How does anti-virus software detect a known virus in a file?

options.text: By comparing file patterns or signatures with a database of known malware
By checking the computer's screen size
By reading the user's handwritten notes

questions.question: What is the primary function of a firewall?

options.text: To monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic according to security rules
To remove dust from computer parts

questions.question: Why are security patches important?

options.text: They make passwords easier to guess
They remove the need for antivirus software
They fix security weaknesses and bugs in software

questions.question: A student's computer suddenly becomes very slow, freezes frequently, displays unusual pop-ups, and takes a long time to shut down. What should the student do first?

options.text: Tell a trusted adult or technician and run a scan using trusted security software
Ignore the symptoms and continue using it
Share personal files with a stranger for help

questions.question: You find a free program on an unfamiliar website. You are unsure whether the website is trustworthy. What is the most responsible choice?

options.text: Avoid downloading it and look for the program from an official, trusted source
Share the link with classmates and ask them to install it

questions.question: Your computer is working normally, but you have not scanned it recently. What would be the most security-conscious habit?

options.text: Wait until the computer stops working
Keep antivirus protection updated and perform regular scans
Download files from unknown websites to test it

questions.question: Which choice best demonstrates responsible computer-security behavior?

options.text: Use the same short password everywhere
Ignore software updates and security warnings
Open every email attachment without checking
Use strong unique passwords, install updates, and avoid suspicious links or downloads
